note: Gantt float and dependency arrows corrected. The dashed float bar now shows FREE float — it fills only the gap between a task and its next dependent task and stops there — instead of total float running all the way to project end, so a task that feeds another no longer shows a float bar stretching across the chart. Critical and terminal tasks show no float bar. Dependency arrows were re-routed MS-Project style (the vertical leg now sits next to the successor), which removes the scattered crossing lines on dense schedules. The Links toggle and the earlier build fix remain.
